label: SPORT SKIFF
authoring: Written by the rig: SportSkiffIso.byId('sport_skiff_iso').walk(), every number its own (mm), stamped with the rig's LF sha256 and fitted to character rig 10.3 (qa.character) by tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs. Regenerate with node tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs --write; never edit by hand.
frame: metres; +x starboard, +y bow, +z up; origin amidships, keel bottom, centreline; polygons counter-clockwise seen from above

walk.rule: A step is legal when the target point is inside an area polygon and outside its holes, and |area z - player z| < stepTol. Ramps interpolate z along their axis (x or y) between a0 and a1, and hold z0 / z1 beyond them. cut = the cutaway key while standing there; cutHi / cutLo replace it above / below zMid (stairs and ladders). Polygons are player-centre: already inset by radius, so the reader never insets them again.

areas.note: the aft bench to the leaning post: 1.262 m of centre room between the stern grab rails, 1.474 m at the post

the port passage past the helm: 0.469 m between the T-top’s forward leg and the hull’s side, 0.006 m of centre room at the walker’s radius. It widens aft and opens into the bow forward of the console.

the starboard passage past the helm: 0.469 m between the T-top’s forward leg and the hull’s side, 0.006 m of centre room at the walker’s radius. It widens aft and opens into the bow forward of the console.
the sole forward of the console, to the casting deck’s step: 1.244 m of centre room aft, 0.58 m at the step

interact.label: Helm
interact.note: a standing console: the pilot stands between it and the leaning post, whose cushion is the perch (seat). Taken from the cockpit, behind the post.

cleats.note: the stainless cleat on the casting deck: the bow line, cast to it (nobody stands there)

_excluded.reason: the standing room at the wheel: 0.368 m between the leaning post and the wheel, under the T-top and between its side braces. Narrower than the walker’s 0.46 m: no centre point fits. The helm is taken from the cockpit, behind the post (interact helm); the pilot stands here (anchors.pilot).

the raised casting deck forward: 0.504 m over the sole at its step (over stepTol 0.34 m) and rising to 1.068 m at the stem. Cockpit-only by the owner’s ruling of 2026-07-22: mooring is a cast line, nobody stands at the bow cleat.
the well between the aft bench and the transom: 0.245 m fore and aft, narrower than the walker’s 0.46 m. The outboards are worked from the cockpit, over the bench.
the gunwales: a 0.063 m rub-rail cap 0.34 m over the sole and 0.43 m over the water. Stepped over to board, not walked. She has no ladder: a swimmer comes aboard over them (ladderOn).
the leaning post: its cushion, 0.59 m over the sole, is the helm’s perch (anchors.helm), not a standing surface. Perching waits on sit.
the aft bench across the stern, its cushion 0.333 m over the sole: a seat. Sitting waits on sit.
an open boat: no side deck. The gunwales are stepped over, not walked (gunwales).
the stern grab rails on each quarter, 0.719 m over the sole: handholds, not mooring points. No stern cleat is drawn: she lies to her bow cleat (bow_1), as she has since her first sidecar.
the bow pulpit’s stainless rail: a handhold over the casting deck, not a mooring point. The bow line is the cleat’s (bow_1).

fitCheck.note: an open boat: no room faces to check

character.method: every frame of each clip for all thirty builds (evalClip + pinsOf), world opts from the walk; hands vs the wheel rim, the lying body vs the berth outline and deckhead, crowns vs headroom, shoulders (2 x collision radius) vs clear widths

fixtures.note: the opts clamp: the clip poses its wheel up to 0.07 m from the hub

Why not: helm_idle takes no wheel opts, so each build holds its hands where its own arms put them: 0.784 to 1.231 m over the floor and 0.312 to 0.482 m ahead of its feet. One wheel is within 0.02 m of a few of those grips at most. This wheel is set for drive (seated, 30 of 30), which takes it no higher than 0.95 m over the floor (this hub: 0.67 m), and its seat is 0.54 m behind the hub, so a figure standing at the reach helm_idle holds would stand in the seat. At the rig’s pilot spot (0.23 m behind the hub) the hands’ midpoint misses the hub by up to 0.615 m. Standing waits on helm_idle taking wheelZ / wheelY (as drive does) and a helm with standing room in front of its seat.

fixtures.what: walk every area (4 of them) at the walker’s radius 0.23 m
fixtures.note: each outline is inset by the walker’s radius, the widest 10.3 build’s collision radius or more: every build’s shoulders fit wherever the walker goes. Headroom is the stand fixtures’; steps are the step fixtures’.

fixtures.what: come aboard from the water (onto gunwales, 0.43 m above the waterline; no ladder)
fixtures.note: no ladder on this hull: a swimmer cannot climb back aboard (see _excluded gunwales)
10.3 has no sit clip: drive is its only seated clip, and its hands hold a wheel
